scenes.premise: You are on a train. Each box is a house you pass, and the window shows exactly 3 at a time.
scenes.narration: Now slide. |The house >entering the window gets ^added, |and the house >leaving gets ^subtracted. %Seven, from two operations instead of three. The window moved, and you never recounted the middle.
